Expected response: Full-time employees get 20 days of annual leave per calendar year; part-time employees get a pro-rated amount.

Question: Can I carry unused annual leave into next year?
Expected response: Yes, up to 5 unused days can be carried into the next year and must be used by 31 March; days beyond 5 are forfeited.

Question: Do I need a doctor's note for sick leave?
